fixes.what: Mis-dated at confidence 2: the recovery of Tabriz, East Azarbaijan, Ardebil, Hamadan and Kermanshah is put in 1735, but it took place in 1730 and was kept by Tahmasp II's treaty of 1732. Only the Caucasus came back in 1734-1735.
fixes.why: Campaigns of Nader Shah, the author's own source: '[Nader] took Tabriz on 12 August' 1730, after Nahavand, Hamadan and Kermanshah. Under Tahmasp's treaty the Ottomans 'would, in exchange, be given back Tabriz, Hamadan and Kermanshah' while he 'accepted Ottoman suzerainty over the Caucasus'. Shamakhi fell 'in August 1734'.
fixes.fix: Split the event. Add a gain in 1730-08 from ottoman-empire of East Azarbaijan, Ardebil, Tabriz, Hamadan and Kermanshah at confidence 3, sourced to the Campaigns of Nader Shah page. Keep the 1735 gain for Transcaucasia only. Move the KF 30 text accordingly.
